en: Vintage color postcard showing stone ruins with a large arched opening and fragmented walls set on a grassy area with tall trees and hills in the background. Several men in early-20th‑century attire stand near the arch. The back side has handwritten text in Hungarian, postal markings, and space for the address. The front caption at the bottom identifies the location as Pécs‑Tettye and mentions details of the ruins.
